data.name: Summer Feed
data.detailed_description:
[Storyline]

You're a college student who couldn't quite graduate on time, so you've moved to a new neighborhood for summer classes and an internship. On your very first day, a neighbor talks you into joining PIA—and just like that, your new life on social media begins.

Spend your days attending classes, hanging out at cafés, and hitting the gym. Head to your internship in the afternoon, or stop by the library to do some research. At night, open PIA, scroll through your feed to see who's posted something new... or slide into someone's DMs.

All those people you see around you, they all live their life in their own way. Some present carefully crafted versions of themselves on PIA, while others say things in DMs that are completely different from their public posts. The version of them you see may not be what they show to a million people.

Each heroine's story takes you from your first meeting to a deeper relationship. The world of PIA is alive, and every action you take influences how things turn out. Let's see where the algorithm takes you!

[Features]

Over 100 post combinations

Rich Social Media Content & A Dynamic Social Feed That Reacts to You

Emotionally rich and highly interactive storylines

[Characters]

Hanna Zheng

A classmate from your summer classes who's studying in the Drama Department. She seems like the most ordinary girl in class, speaking slowly and keeping a low profile. Her PIA account is completely empty, but she seems to know exactly what you're thinking...

Jean Chen

Your direct supervisor at the company where you're interning. Precise and efficient, she replies to work messages within three seconds and doesn't like to talk about her personal life. At the company, she's working with you on a concert project for the insanely popular boy band WØLF4.

Vivian Lin
A well-known influencer on PIA who lives next door to you. Her writing is emotionally nuanced and highly observant, though a carefree vibe seems to permeate all her work. However, you've noticed that the way she finds inspiration is somewhat "unusual."


Merry
The owner of the neighborhood barbershop. Talkative and skillful, always calls you handsome, but lately seems worried about the dwindling number of customers.

Jolie
A junior who works at the school library. A geology major and a total fossil nerd. She's so obsessed that she's gone through every fossil documentary the library has to offer.


Kevin
The gym bro. Kind-hearted and treats you like a brother. Always happy to share his fitness knowledge... and leave you with sore legs.

data.short_description: <i>Summer Feed</i> is an emotionally charged, interactive game centered around social media management. Manage your PIA account, get inspired, and post dope content! Different people will respond to every post, but what they show on PIA is never the same as what's in your DMs...
